name: Submitting a valid request adds it to My Requests as Waiting for Supervisor and persists

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and log in with email 'flow.submit@leave-portal.test' and password 'password' using the 'Log in' button.
Select 'Annual Leave' as leave type, set Start date to 2026-11-16 and End date to 2026-11-16, and enter reason 'E2E submit marker'.
The page redirects to the request detail page and shows the status badge 'Waiting for Supervisor' plus a success message mentioning the request was submitted.
Open the 'My Requests' page via the sidebar link (URL /requests).
A request card containing the reason 'E2E submit marker' is visible with the status 'Waiting for Supervisor'.
After reload, the 'E2E submit marker' request is still visible with the status 'Waiting for Supervisor'.
